note: The five shots of the showcase of Bãi Trước (plan 0026, R15, section 3). Each shot has the photo that it must match (a link only), the eye (x and z of the game: the eye is eye_height m over the ground, or over the floor of a known place), the point that the camera looks at (x, y, z of the game), and the vertical field of view of the camera in degrees (fov: 40 is about the view of a phone camera at 16:9). PT-72 takes each shot at each time of "times", on Low (the Mobile renderer) and on High (Forward+). The positions are from the roads of OpenStreetMap (data/geo/build/roads.json) and from the survey of World plan 0018.

shots.note: The photo of the walk (2015) looks to the south-east along the walk, with the raised lawns of OSM (ways 234797329 and 234797330) on its left. Its geotag (x -18, z -266) is about 50 m from that place, so the eye is on the walk at the north-west end of the raised lawns.
